It is to be regretted that Alice Childress’ Trouble in Mind had to wait this long to reach Broadway but it was worth the wait. Ironically, it can be better appreciated now when so many revelations have come out than back in the late 1950’s when it might have been dismissed as going too far.
The two main reasons to see Trouble in Mind: its path-breaking revelation of still-burning issues rarely addressed so frankly onstage when it was written; its outstanding performance by LaChanze.
